name: Hand-drawn / sketchbook / cel boil
look: pencil and ink on paper, line boil, smears, hand lettering.

fits.notes: human-centred products, creative tools, education, indie

when_not: Avoid anything needing exact UI proof.

type.guidance: hand lettering, Caveat-like but better (Reenie, custom)
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: hand lettering, Caveat-like but better (Reenie, custom); graphite + one marker colour on cream.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: marker colour is the brand colour on graphite and cream
brand_lock.type_role: hand lettering for callouts; brand face for the one typeset claim
brand_lock.world_changes: line boil, smears, hand-lettered callouts, paper turns
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: pencil and ink sketch of {subject}, graphite plus one marker colour on cream paper, 3 alternate redraws
codex_assets.r1_note: hand-drawn plates in 3 alt versions; A5.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.recipe: `runtime/medium-cel.js`, `styles/cel-boil.md`, `sketchbook.md`, `motion/traditional/cel-on-twos.md`, `anime-timing-kanada-smear.md`. SVG `feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap` seeded by `floor(t*12)` for boil.

examples.title: Animade (Figma, Google, Airbnb motion; acquired by Duolingo) ; Gunner/Duolingo World

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

palettes.words: kraft paper, graphite, red marker, blue ballpoint

palettes.name: Notebook grid
palettes.words: off-white grid page, soft black, orange marker, teal

palettes.name: Chalk board
palettes.words: slate green, chalk white, yellow, mint

brand_lock.rule: Brand colour is the marker used for emphasis (underlines, circles, the hero fill); paper and pencil stay style-fixed. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Handwriting; jitter each word 1-2 degrees; underline with a marker stroke.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Scrawl for the loose, funny read.

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: page spread with 10% margin; sketches loosely arranged with arrows and annotations; line boil on 2s
composition.fill: half the page is drawing, half blank
composition.product_ui: UI is a taped-in printout or a sketched phone with the real UI in its screen

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: flat top-down of a notebook page, 50 mm, slight page curl at the edge. Lighting: soft overhead desk light, pencil sheen, subtle shadow of a taped photo. Material: graphite pencil, felt marker, ballpoint on paper with erased ghost lines. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: paper tooth, smudges, eraser marks. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no digital clean lines, no vector shapes, no perfect circles, no gradients, no readable invented text.
codex.camera: flat top-down of a notebook page, 50 mm, slight page curl at the edge
codex.lighting: soft overhead desk light, pencil sheen, subtle shadow of a taped photo
codex.material: graphite pencil, felt marker, ballpoint on paper with erased ghost lines
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: graphite pencil; flat top-down of a notebook page; kraft paper, graphite, red marker, blue ballpoint.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.

do: Boil the line on 2s (each frame redrawn slightly)
Let mistakes show: erasures, double lines
Annotate with arrows and handwritten labels
cheap_ways: Handwriting font on a white background with no drawing
A line-boil filter applied to clean vectors
Every sketch evenly spaced like a template
